beats.action: Dev sits on a lawn chair staring blankly at a plate of turkey.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.text: Dev, you have been staring at that corn for ten minutes straight.

dialogue.speaker: Dev
dialogue.text: I just keep thinking about Saquon's injury. Everything feels so fragile.

beats.action: Priya walks over with a bowl of mashed potatoes and sighs softly.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.text: It is Thanksgiving, babe. The only thing fragile here is this crust.

dialogue.speaker: Dev
dialogue.text: He was our season hero, Priya. Our actual fantasy football hero.

beats.action: Dev dramatically drops his plastic fork and looks at the sky.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.text: You are mourning a running back like he is your blood relative.

dialogue.speaker: Dev
dialogue.text: He gave his all, and now I cannot even flip this burger.

beats.action: Priya sits down next to him and puts an arm around him.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.text: Channel your inner Marshawn Lynch and just 'bout that action, boss.

dialogue.speaker: Dev
dialogue.text: Did you just quote Beast Mode to get me to eat?

beats.action: Dev takes a huge bite of potato and smiles at Priya.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.text: It worked, didn't it? Now try this sweet potato mash, please.

dialogue.speaker: Dev
dialogue.text: Okay, fine. This mash is more reliable than my entire draft.

music_prompt: Soft acoustic lo-fi guitar with a warm, autumnal chill-hop beat.
caption: When the fantasy football stats hit harder than the turkey coma. 🏈🍗

history_entry.hook: Dev mourns Saquon Barkley's injury during dinner.
history_entry.core_joke: Priya uses a Marshawn Lynch quote to cure Dev's sports-induced depression.
